items.name: Scheduled watering
items.text: The controller shall water each irrigation zone according to a user-defined weekly schedule (start time and duration per zone).

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Moisture-based skipping
items.text: The controller shall skip a scheduled watering of a zone when the measured soil moisture of that zone is above the configured threshold.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Rain-aware watering
items.text: The controller shall reduce the watering duration when rain is forecast within the next 24 hours.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Leak protection
items.text: The controller shall close all valves and alert the user when the measured water flow exceeds the expected flow by more than 30 % for 60 seconds.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Mobile control
items.text: The user shall be able to start and stop any zone from the mobile application.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Schedule retention
items.text: The controller shall retain all schedules and settings through a power loss of up to 72 hours.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Zone capacity
items.text: The controller shall support up to 8 irrigation zones.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Manual override
items.text: A physical button on the controller shall run the selected zone for 5 minutes regardless of the schedule.

coverage.rule: software requirement OR work item

items.name: Schedule persistence
items.text: The software shall store schedules and settings in non-volatile memory and reload them at start-up.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Schedule execution
items.text: The software shall open the valve of a zone at the scheduled start time and close it after the scheduled duration, with a timing accuracy of 2 seconds.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Moisture sampling
items.text: The software shall read every soil moisture sensor at least once every 10 minutes.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Moisture skip rule
items.text: The software shall skip the next scheduled run of a zone when the latest moisture reading of that zone exceeds the zone threshold (default 60 %).

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Forecast retrieval
items.text: The software shall retrieve the 24-hour precipitation forecast from the weather service every 6 hours and shall use the last successful forecast for at most 24 hours when the service is unavailable.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Rain reduction
items.text: The software shall reduce the duration of scheduled runs by the configured rain factor (default 50 %) when the precipitation probability for the next 24 hours exceeds 70 %.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Flow monitoring
items.text: The software shall compute the expected flow of each zone from its calibration and compare it with the measured flow every second.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Leak shutdown
items.text: The software shall close all valves within 2 seconds and raise a leak alert when the measured flow exceeds the expected flow by more than 30 % for 60 consecutive seconds.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: App command handling
items.text: The software shall execute start and stop commands received from the mobile application within 1 second.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Manual button run
items.text: The software shall run the selected zone for 5 minutes when the manual button is pressed and shall stop the run on a second press.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Zone limit
items.text: The software shall accept configuration for zones 1 to 8 and shall reject any zone number above 8.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Alert notification
items.text: The software shall send a push notification containing the zone number and the time of the event for every leak alert.

coverage.rule: architecture AND test AND work item

items.name: Scheduler
items.text: Runs the weekly schedule and applies the rain factor.

items.name: Config Store
items.text: Non-volatile storage of schedules, thresholds and zone configuration.

items.name: Zone Controller
items.text: Drives the valve outputs of the 8 zones.

items.name: Moisture Monitor
items.text: Samples the soil moisture sensors and evaluates the skip rule.

items.name: Weather Client
items.text: Fetches the precipitation forecast from the weather service.

items.name: Flow Guard
items.text: Compares measured and expected flow and triggers the leak shutdown.

items.name: App Gateway
items.text: Receives commands from the mobile application.

items.name: Manual Control
items.text: Handles the manual override button.

items.name: Notification Service
items.text: Sends push notifications to the user.

items.name: Schedule reload after power cycle
items.text: Configure two zones, power-cycle the controller, check that both schedules are present.

items.name: Start time accuracy
items.text: Schedule zone 3 at 06:00 for 10 min, measure valve open and close times.

items.name: Moisture sampling period
items.text: Log sensor reads for one hour, check at least six reads per sensor.

items.name: Skip on wet soil
items.text: Set zone threshold 50 %, inject 65 % reading, confirm the next run is skipped.

items.name: Forecast fallback
items.text: Block the weather service, confirm the last forecast is used for 24 h then discarded.

items.name: Rain reduction
items.text: Inject 80 % precipitation probability, confirm run durations are halved.

items.name: Leak shutdown timing
items.text: Inject 40 % excess flow for 60 s, confirm all valves close within 2 s and an alert is raised.

items.name: App stop command
items.text: Send stop from the app during a run, confirm the valve closes within 1 s.

items.name: Manual button run
items.text: Press the button, confirm 5 min run; press again, confirm the run stops.

items.name: Zone limit
items.text: Configure zone 9, confirm the configuration is rejected.

items.name: Alert notification content
items.text: Trigger a leak alert, check the notification carries zone and time.

items.name: Rain-aware watering
items.text: Reduce watering when rain is forecast, so that the customer saves water without touching the schedule.

items.name: Leak protection
items.text: Detect a burst pipe or a stuck valve from the flow measurement and shut the water off. Required for the WaterWise rebate listing of Release 1.1; the program audit in November needs the trace from requirement to test evidence.

items.name: Fetch the 24-hour forecast from the weather service
items.text: As the scheduler I need the precipitation probability for the next 24 hours, refreshed every 6 hours, with a fallback to the last good forecast.

items.name: Reduce zone run time when rain is likely
items.text: Apply the rain factor to every scheduled run while the precipitation probability is above 70 %.

items.name: Compute the expected flow per zone
items.text: Derive the expected flow from the zone calibration and compare it with the flow meter reading once a second.

items.name: Close all valves and alert on a leak
items.text: When the excess flow condition holds for 60 s, close every valve within 2 s and raise the leak alert.

items.name: Persist schedules in non-volatile memory
items.text: Store schedules, thresholds and zone configuration in flash and reload them at start-up.

items.name: Run a zone from the manual button
items.text: A press runs the selected zone for 5 minutes; a second press stops it.

items.name: Send a push notification for alerts
items.text: Every leak alert produces a push notification with the zone number and the time of the event.

items.name: Reject zone numbers above the limit
items.text: Zone configuration above the supported count must be refused with an error. Note: the requirement ID in this story is wrong on purpose; Reqtify reports it as an unresolved reference.

items.name: Moisture skip rule ignores the per-zone threshold
items.text: The skip decision always uses the global default of 60 % even when a zone has its own threshold.

items.name: Valve stays open after a stop command from the app
items.text: Stop sent from the mobile application during a scheduled run is acknowledged but the valve closes only at the scheduled end.

items.name: Weather fetch retries endlessly when offline
items.text: Without network the client retries every second and starves the scheduler task.

items.name: Regression test the leak shutdown timing
items.text: Re-run the leak shutdown test on the release candidate and attach the timing log.

items.name: Update the weather service interface description to v2
items.text: The weather provider moves to API v2 in December. Document the new endpoint and fields. No requirement reference on purpose: Reqtify lists this work item as not traced.

items.name: Change request: raise the leak detection threshold from 30 % to 40 %
items.text: Support ticket cluster INC-2041 (September 2026): 23 installations with long drip zones reported false leak alerts; pressure build-up on zone start exceeds the 30 % margin for more than 60 s. Product management proposes 40 %. Before approval we need the impact on the system requirement, the software requirements, the Flow Guard block and the leak tests, and the regression scope for Release 1.1.
